notes: The Fandom overview confirms 41 pose-pack rows in the approved sections.
Overview table prices are used for card prices when an individual page disagrees, because overview rows are the collection-level source of truth for Phase 2A.
Only Editorial, Petal, and Ice Skating had meaningful price or route conflicts after normalizing commas/currency labels.
Pose counts are included only when the individual page has a clear count without a detected conflict. Conflicting or unknown counts are left null with poseCountStatus notes.
Roblox Classic Pose Pack image is intentionally blank because the source table image is The Classic event logo rather than a clean pose-pack icon.
